# CWE-326: Inadequate Encryption Strength — Detection in IaC Scripts

## Necessary Weaknesses to Detect

### 1. Weak Key Length Specification
Using cryptographic keys below the minimum recommended bit lengths for a given algorithm makes encryption susceptible to brute-force attacks.

### 2. Deprecated or Weak Algorithm Selection
Explicitly configuring outdated or cryptographically broken algorithms that no longer meet modern security standards.

### 3. Permissive TLS/SSL Protocol Version
Allowing legacy protocol versions that contain known vulnerabilities or use weaker cipher negotiation.

### 4. Weak Cipher Suite Configuration
Defining cipher suites that rely on short keys, export-grade encryption, or broken cipher primitives.

### 5. Insufficient Key Specification for Asymmetric Cryptography
Configuring asymmetric key parameters below accepted thresholds for key exchange or digital signatures.

### 6. Weak Hashing Algorithm Used in Cryptographic Context
Applying MD5 or SHA-1 for certificate signing, HMAC, or key derivation where stronger hashes are required.

---

## Keywords, Attributes, and Fields

### Algorithm / Cipher Identifiers
| Keyword / Value | Implication |
|---|---|
| `DES`, `3DES`, `TripleDES` | Broken/weak symmetric cipher |
| `RC2`, `RC4`, `RC5` | Weak or broken stream/block cipher |
| `Blowfish` | Short block size (64-bit), legacy |
| `MD5`, `SHA1`, `SHA-1` | Weak hash in cryptographic context |
| `AES-128` | Acceptable but insufficient for high-assurance contexts |
| `NULL`, `EXPORT`, `ANON` | No or minimal encryption |

---

### Key Length / Key Size Fields
| Field Name | Risk Indicator |
|---|---|
| `key_length` | Value < 2048 (RSA/DSA), < 256 (ECC) |
| `key_size` | Same thresholds as above |
| `rsa_bits` | Value < 2048 |
| `key_bits` | Value < 128 (symmetric) |
| `modulus_length` | Value < 2048 |
| `bit_length` | Context-dependent threshold |

---

### TLS/SSL Protocol Version Fields
| Field Name | Weak Values |
|---|---|
| `minimum_tls_version` | `TLSv1`, `TLSv1.0`, `TLSv1.1`, `SSLv2`, `SSLv3` |
| `ssl_policy` | Policies referencing `TLS-1-0`, `TLS-1-1`, `ELBSecurityPolicy-2015` |
| `security_policy` | Any policy permitting pre-TLS 1.2 |
| `tls_version` | `1.0`, `1.1` |
| `protocol` | `SSLv2`, `SSLv3`, `TLS1`, `TLS1.1` |
| `min_protocol_version` | Values below `TLSv1.2` |

---

### Cipher Suite Fields
| Field Name | Risky Patterns |
|---|---|
| `cipher_suite` | Contains `RC4`, `DES`, `EXPORT`, `NULL`, `ANON`, `MD5` |
| `ciphers` | Inclusion of weak identifiers above |
| `ssl_ciphers` | Same as above |
| `cipher_algorithms` | Weak algorithm names |

---

### Encryption Key Specification Fields
| Field Name | Risk Indicator |
|---|---|
| `kms_key_spec` | `AES_128` instead of `AES_256` |
| `encryption_algorithm` | Weak algorithm names |
| `key_spec` | `RSA_2048` is minimum; `RSA_1024` is weak |
| `signing_algorithm` | `SHA1withRSA`, `MD5withRSA` |
| `certificate_algorithm` | SHA-1 based values |

---

### Storage / Transport Encryption Fields
| Field Name | Risk Indicator |
|---|---|
| `server_side_encryption` | Weak or unspecified algorithm |
| `encryption_at_rest` | Algorithm field with weak value |
| `ssl_mode` | `VERIFY_CA` without strong cipher enforcement |
| `volume_encryption` | Weak key size reference |
| `transit_encryption` | Permitting downgrade to weak ciphers |

---

## Summary Table

| Weakness | Key Field Pattern | Risky Value Examples |
|---|---|---|
| Weak key size | `key_length`, `rsa_bits`, `key_size` | `< 2048` (asymmetric), `< 128` (symmetric) |
| Weak algorithm | `algorithm`, `cipher`, `encryption_algorithm` | `DES`, `3DES`, `RC4`, `Blowfish` |
| Weak TLS version | `minimum_tls_version`, `ssl_policy` | `TLSv1.0`, `TLSv1.1`, `SSLv3` |
| Weak cipher suite | `cipher_suite`, `ciphers`, `ssl_ciphers` | `EXPORT`, `NULL`, `RC4`, `DES` |
| Weak hash in crypto | `signing_algorithm`, `digest` | `MD5`, `SHA1`, `SHA-1` |
| Weak KMS key spec | `kms_key_spec`, `key_spec` | `AES_128`, `RSA_1024` |

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

asymmetric_key_fields := {"rsa_bits", "key_length", "key_size", "modulus_length", "bit_length"}

tls_version_fields := {"minimum_tls_version", "tls_version", "protocol", "min_protocol_version", "ssl_policy", "security_policy"}

algorithm_fields := {"algorithm", "encryption_algorithm", "cipher", "cipher_suite", "ciphers", "ssl_ciphers", "cipher_algorithms", "kms_key_spec", "key_spec", "signing_algorithm", "certificate_algorithm"}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == asymmetric_key_fields[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Integer"
    attr.value.value < 2048
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Asymmetric key size is below the recommended minimum of 2048 bits. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == "key_bits"
    attr.value.ir_type == "Integer"
    attr.value.value < 128
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Symmetric key size is below the recommended minimum of 128 bits. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == algorithm_fields[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match(`(?i).*(^|[^A-Za-z])(DES|3DES|TripleDES|RC2|RC4|RC5|Blowfish|MD5|SHA-?1|NULL|EXPORT|ANON|AES[-_]128|RSA[-_]1024|SHA1with|MD5with)([^A-Za-z]|$).*`, attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Weak or deprecated cryptographic algorithm configured. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    atomic_units := glitch_lib.all_atomic_units(parent)
    node := atomic_units[_]
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(node)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == tls_version_fields[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match(`(?i).*(TLSv?1\.[01]|SSLv?[23]|TLS-1-[01]|ELBSecurityPolicy-2015).*`, attr.value.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Weak or deprecated TLS/SSL protocol version configured. (CWE-326)"
    }
}
